description: This file defines the 'History' class within the AWS SDK for PHP, serving as a container to track and record command, request, and response history for debugging and middleware purposes.

classes.name: History
classes.description: A container class that records and manages the history of commands, requests, and responses for AWS SDK operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the history container with an optional maximum number of entries.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the history.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over the entries.

methods.name: getLastCommand
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent command executed.

methods.name: getLastRequest
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent request sent.

methods.name: getLastReturn
methods.description: Retrieves the last result or exception recorded.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins recording a new command and request, returns a unique ticket identifier.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Completes recording an entry associated with a ticket, storing the result or exception.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the history entries as an array.
